The best TikTok creator discovery tool is the one that lets you filter for creators who actually sell in your category, by GMV, niche, and engagement, in seconds instead of hours of manual scrolling. Discovery tools solve the finding problem specifically, which is different from full affiliate platforms that also handle outreach and management. Here is how to think about the category and pick.

Discovery vs full platform

Two different jobs get bundled together, so be clear on what you need:

  • Discovery tools find and filter creators. That is the job: search a large database by category, GMV band, audience, and engagement to build a shortlist.
  • Full affiliate platforms (Reacher, Euka, Cruva) include discovery but add outreach automation, sampling, and management.

If your bottleneck is only finding creators, a focused discovery tool is cheaper and simpler. If you need the whole workflow, see best affiliate software.

What good discovery filtering looks like

Discovery is a two-way fit problem, and creators feel the mismatch as sharply as brands do. One of the most-upvoted recent r/UGCcreators threads argues that "a lot of creators on this subreddit are chasing the wrong brands" (r/UGCcreators). The same is true in reverse: brands chase the wrong creators. Good filtering is how you avoid being the wrong brand for a creator and the creator being wrong for you.

The filters that matter for TikTok Shop:

  • Category and niche, so you find sellers in your space.
  • GMV band, to sort proven sellers from tourists.
  • Audience geography and demographics, to match your buyer.
  • Engagement and follower range, to catch fake or dead audiences.

The Tokgency creator finder is built around exactly this: search by niche, see who sells, and reveal contact details when you are ready to reach out.

The main options

  • Tokgency creator finder for TikTok Shop seller discovery with contact reveal.
  • Kalodata for analytics-led discovery (trending products, top creators, viral videos).
  • Reacher, Euka, Cruva if you want discovery plus outreach and management in one platform.
  • TikTok Affiliate Center as the free, manual baseline; fine to start, slow at scale. See the Affiliate Center guide.

How to choose

  • Just need a shortlist fast: a focused discovery tool or the Tokgency finder.
  • Need data on products and trends too: Kalodata.
  • Need the full workflow: a complete affiliate platform.
  • Do not want to operate any of it: a managed agency that does discovery and everything after.

The takeaway

Discovery is the first step, not the whole job. Pick a tool that filters hard on category selling behavior, build a shortlist of proven sellers, then decide whether you also need outreach and management tooling or a team to run it.

Want to find sellers in your niche right now? Search the creator finder, or book a call to have the roster built for you.
